name: Pitch Play
description: One sample or many, played chromatically on the pads and from a MIDI keyboard
changelog: 0.4.1: notes are spelled the way the key spells them -- Eb, Bb, Ab and Db in the six flat keys, sharps elsewhere. A progression written in Eb reading "D#" on the pads was the right sound on the wrong piece of paper.

0.4.0: forty-six progressions through core 1.45 -- the thirty jazz, soul, lo-fi and trap ones included -- and picking one now brings its mode with it, so Backdoor arrives in Mixolydian and Lydian Dream in Lydian instead of being read as degrees of whatever was selected.

0.3.1: the chord list follows core 1.44 -- ninth chords and eight R&B/soul progressions (Soul Turn, ii-V-I, Gospel, Deceptive, Minor Soul, Tritone, Neo-Soul, Soul Shuffle). The editor cycles chord types by MusicTheory::playableChordCount() rather than a literal twelve.

0.3.0: the music comes from crosspad::MusicTheory instead of this file -- nine scales, fourteen chord types (Diatonic among them, which takes its quality from the degree) and eight progressions, none of which was reachable before because nothing linked it. SCALE picks key, scale, transpose and chord; "Own progression" edits up to eight progressions of your own, steps of (degree, chord), kept in NVS across a reboot and playing the moment they are saved. Requires core 1.42.

0.2.0: key, scale, transpose and chords. The pads are sixteen degrees of a scale from a key (chromatic, major, minor, dorian, mixolydian, two pentatonics, blues, harmonic minor) shifted by a transpose of -12..+12; a pad can play a power chord, a triad, a 7th or an octave, built from the scale so it stays in key -- and from fixed intervals on chromatic, where two degrees is a whole tone. SCALE on the top row opens the window and carries the answer ("C maj"); a dot marks chords on.

0.1.0: an instrument from one sample or many, picked from a drop-down (saved instruments, the Recorder's takes, the whole card); the pads play it chromatically from a base note, OCT moves it, a MIDI keyboard plays it too; EDIT lists the zones -- add one from the card, remove one, set its root or leave it to detection; SAVE keeps it in /crosspad/pitchplay with its samples copied in; the engine is borrowed from the kits while the app is open (core 1.38 IInstrumentHost); requires core 1.38 and gui 1.18
